notes: The whole Anthropic API (api.anthropic.com) as Anthropic's own Stainless-generated OpenAPI 3.1 document, committed verbatim. Stainless stopped publishing the hosted spec URL in the SDKs' .stats.yml and the old GCS bucket is gone, but every Anthropic SDK still ships the same spec gzip-compressed as scripts/mock-spec.json.gz; upstream.json is that file gunzipped (contentHash is of the decompressed bytes, reproducible with curl | gunzip | sha256sum), and openapi.json is it plus the x-openfn-adaptor stamp. 385 operations over 253 paths and 2235 component schemas: Messages (create, count_tokens, batches), Models, Files, Skills, the Admin/organization API (users, workspaces, API keys, invites, usage/cost reports, analytics, RBAC, spend limits), and the beta Managed Agents surface (agents, sessions, environments, deployments, memory stores, vaults, tunnels, dreams, user profiles). Stainless models beta variants as separate path keys with a literal '?beta=true' suffix, so endpoints.md shows paired '<resource>' and '<resource>?beta=true' groups; that is upstream's shape and is kept unedited. The spec declares no securitySchemes (auth is x-api-key plus the anthropic-version header, per the docs). The claude adaptor (v1.2.1) exposes one operation, prompt, which calls client.messages.create in @anthropic-ai/sdk, i.e. POST /v1/messages, present as messages_post. Replaces a hand-authored 8-operation stub.
